name: Documentation Generator Agent
description: An agent that creates project documentation including README files and API docs, and validates the output format for correctness and completeness.

readme-generation.description: Generates well-structured README files with standard sections (title, description, installation, usage, contributing, license)

tests.description: Generated README contains all standard sections
tests.prompt: Generate a README.md for a Node.js CLI tool called 'taskflow' that manages developer workflows. Include all standard sections.

tests.description: Generated README uses valid markdown formatting
tests.prompt: Generate a README.md for a Python REST API library called 'quickapi'. Keep it concise but complete.

tests.description: README includes code examples in fenced code blocks
tests.prompt: Generate a README for a JavaScript utility library called 'arraykit' that provides array manipulation functions. Include usage examples.

api-docs-generation.description: Generates API documentation with endpoint descriptions, parameters, request/response examples, and error codes

tests.description: API docs describe endpoints with method, path, parameters, and responses
tests.prompt: Generate API documentation for a user management REST API with endpoints: POST /users (create), GET /users/:id (get by id), PUT /users/:id (update), DELETE /users/:id (delete). Include request/response examples.

tests.description: API docs include HTTP status codes for success and error cases
tests.prompt: Generate API documentation for a GET /products endpoint that returns a paginated list of products. Include all relevant HTTP status codes.

tests.description: API docs include JSON request/response body examples
tests.prompt: Generate API documentation for a POST /orders endpoint that creates a new order with items, quantities, and shipping address. Show example request and response bodies.

tests.description: API docs include parameter names and their descriptions
tests.prompt: Generate API documentation for a GET /search endpoint with query parameters: q (search term), page (page number), limit (results per page), sort (sort field), order (asc/desc).

format-validation.description: Validates that generated documentation follows correct markdown structure, uses consistent heading hierarchy, and has no broken references

tests.description: Agent identifies and flags incorrect heading hierarchy in documentation
tests.prompt:
Review this documentation for format issues:

# My Project
#### Deep heading
## Installation
# Another top heading
### Skipped level

List all heading hierarchy problems you find.

Validate the format of this documentation and report any issues:

# API Reference

## GET /users
Returns all users
```json
{"users": []}

## POST /users
Creates a user

Note the unclosed code block above. What format problems exist?

tests.description: When generating docs, the agent validates its own output before presenting it
tests.prompt: Generate a short README for a project called 'logstream' and then validate that your output has correct markdown formatting. State whether the format passes validation.

context-awareness.description: Adapts documentation content and style based on the project type, tech stack, and target audience

tests.description: Documentation reflects the specific technology stack mentioned
tests.prompt: Generate a README for a Rust CLI tool called 'cargobench' that benchmarks Cargo build times. Use Rust-appropriate installation and usage instructions.

tests.description: Agent does not invent features or endpoints not described in the prompt
tests.prompt: Generate minimal API documentation for exactly one endpoint: GET /health that returns {"status": "ok"}. Do not add any other endpoints.

tests.description: Agent always produces substantive documentation output
tests.prompt: Generate a brief API doc section for a WebSocket endpoint ws://localhost:8080/stream that streams real-time price updates.
